definitions.explanation: A document issued by schools to students and parents, showing grades, attendance, and teacher comments. Given at the end of each school term.

examples.japanese: {通信簿|つうしんぼ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
{通信簿|つうしんぼ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}せる→見せる：01988_miseru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{怖|こわ}かった→怖い：00864_kowai⟧。
examples.english: I was afraid to show my report card to my parents.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学期末|がっきまつ}→学期末：27585_gakkimatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{通信簿|つうしんぼ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{渡|わた}される→渡す：02442_watasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ドキドキしている→ドキドキする：21628_dokidokisuru⟧。
examples.english: The children are nervous because report cards are handed out at the end of the term.

notes:
The informal, commonly used name for a school report card. The formal name is ⟦{通知表|つうちひょう}→通知表：08604_tsuuchihyou⟧ or {通知票|つうちひょう}, but {通信簿|つうしんぼ} is the term most people grew up using and is deeply associated with school memories.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japanese schools typically have three terms, and {通信簿|つうしんぼ} are given at the end of each. Grades are often on a 5-point scale (5 being the best). The report card also includes teacher comments and attendance records. Receiving the {通信簿|つうしんぼ} at the end-of-term ceremony is a memorable school ritual.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通信簿|つうしんぼ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧ — to receive a report card
- {通信簿|つうしんぼ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せる→見せる：01988_miseru⟧ — to show one's report card
- {通信簿|つうしんぼ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧ — grades on the report card

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{通知表|つうちひょう}→通知表：08604_tsuuchihyou⟧ — report card; the more formal/official name
- ⟦{成績表|せいせきひょう}→成績表：09289_seisekihyou⟧ — grade sheet, transcript; used at higher levels
- {内申書|ないしんしょ} — school report for high school admissions; an internal evaluation sent by the school
